messages:
Sara: Quick sync — need to lock scope for Optimize Toolkit next sprint. Customers are pushing three things: quantization recommendations for 7B/13B models, an adaptive batching policy blueprint, and eval-triggered regression alerts. What should be must-have for beta vs nice-to-have? Constraints: 2 eng weeks per stream, minimal infra changes, and clear ops rollbacks.
Jim: From runtime POV — must-have: a simple adaptive batching policy (rules + example config) that we can ship without kernel changes. Nice-to-have: auto-apply quant profiles. For alerts, MVP can be a daily digest rather than real-time streaming.
Kelly: Quant recs need per-model eval harness + perf telemetry. Proposal: sample-based recommendations (few hundred prompts) with safety margins and a fallback to unquantized variant. Also include guidance on tradeoffs (latency vs perplexity/accuracy) per model family.
Daniel: Ops concerns: we need audit logs and an explicit rollback plan if a quant profile causes quality regressions. Canary rollout gate is required. Suggest targets: no >10% P95 latency increase and <2% relative quality drop on our eval suites.
Anna: Customer feedback: they'll accept daily alerts if we include clear remediation steps and a one-click toggle in Console. They also want per-route policy and example remediation text they can send to their teams.
Sara: Draft proposal for Beta:
- Adaptive batching blueprint + console toggle for enabling per-route
- Quantization recommendations surfaced as non-auto suggestions (with example prompts/results)
- Eval-triggered alerts as daily digest + ticket/webhook integration
Launch gates:
1) Perf guardrail tests (automated)
2) Canary runbook + rollback validated in staging
3) 2 pilot customers committed to try beta
Does that align? If so I'll write the MRD and triage scope into slices.
Kelly: +1. For recommendations include suggested quant levels (e.g., int8, q4f16) per model class and an example accuracy/latency table for 7B vs 13B.
Jim: I'll draft a minimal telemetry schema we need: tokens, seq_len, model_variant, quant_profile, latency P50/P95, error_rate. Will aim to open a PR with the schema and a sample ingestion example.
Daniel: I'll own the canary playbook and alert thresholds. Estimate ~2w of SRE/eng time to validate rollouts and rollback hooks.
Sara: Action items:
- Sara -> MRD by Friday
- Jim -> telemetry schema PR by Monday
- Kelly -> eval scripts + sample results by Tuesday
- Daniel -> canary playbook + runbook by Wednesday
- Anna -> surface which pilot customers are available for signups
@deploy-bot please create a tracking ticket on the product board for scope and milestones.
Anna: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-1203 on the product board for "Optimize Toolkit: batching/quant/alerts beta". Links: https://board.internal.prod/PROD-1203
